summary: Set ordered enumerator names for an ASCET enumeration

args.name: --item
args.description: One enumerator name. Repeat to preserve explicit order.

args.name: --items
args.description: Comma- or semicolon-separated enumerator names in ordinal order.

args.name: --verify-readback
args.description: Verify exact ordered enumerator readback after writing.

preconditions: ASCET ToolAPI session must be available.
Live ASCET access must run through the serial executor.
Target ASCET path must resolve to an enumeration.

examples.description: Set three ordered enumerators with readback verification

pitfalls: Enumerator names must be non-empty and unique; order defines ordinal values.
Executed ascet_edit writes always request automatic readback verification.
